title: A/P Summary: clicking a vendor opens A/P Unpaid Invoices with the same filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with bills at location A more than 90 days past due on yesterday's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the as-of date set to yesterday, "91+ days" ticked in the Past due filter and only location A ticked in the Location filter.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A/P Unpaid Invoices opens.
  • Only vendor A is ticked on the Vendor chip.
  • The as-of date is yesterday.
  • The Past due chip reads "Past due: 91+ days".
  • Only location A is ticked.

The developers deliver the reports family by family (tech plan, 21 Oct 2026): until A/P Unpaid Invoices itself is updated on the build, the click opens it with only the as-of date and the vendor, as today. If A/P Unpaid Invoices on the build still looks as before the release (no Past due or Location chip), mark this test Blocked: "A/P Unpaid Invoices not yet updated on this build", not Failed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R11: “Clicking a customer or vendor on A/R Summary or A/P Summary opens A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices with just that customer or vendor ticked, the same as-of date, the same ticked Past due ranges and the same ticked locations.”
  • Key Decisions, drill-down: “Drill-down keeps the report's scope. Clicking a customer or vendor on a Summary opens Collection or Unpaid Invoices with the same as-of date and the same chosen locations. Basis: d-drill-in-inherits-scope.”
  • What changes for existing users: “Clicking a row no longer opens it. The document number, or the customer or vendor name on the Summaries, is the link, as on the newer reports (Story 7).”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §6 Phase 3, frontend: “switch the name link to the full drill-down scope (S5-R11): asOfDate, customerIds/vendorIds = [id], pastDue, locationIds (only when not All)”
  • Tech plan §6 Phase 2, frontend: “Until Phase 3 the link keeps today's target query (asOfDate, customerId, customerName), because the legacy Collection page reads only those;”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
